text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While visiting a nearby town with Inari One…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, ya feelin' hungry yet? Wanna get somethin' to eat?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: This feels familiar. Didn't somethin' like this happen back when we went for inari sushi?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whaddaya say we grab somethin' tasty again and find a place with a good view? Kick back and enjoy the finer things.
choice_data_list: Yeah, sure. Do you know this area well?
Yeah, sure. Do you know this area well?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Nah, not at all. No worries though.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Follow me! I promise ya won't regret it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As we stroll around town looking for a restaurant, Inari One stops in front of an old-fashioned store selling dango rice dumplings.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'd say so, yeah. Most of the stores 'round here are old, but here you can see the care they put into the place by how tidy it is.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Plus, you can tell they're confident in their product! Just look at how they've got mitarashi dango written all big and eye-catchin'.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Trusting Inari One's keen perception, we buy some dango. And then…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Now, that's one helluva view! There's just somethin' charmin' about the scenery in an unfamiliar town.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: How's about we lay out the dango somewhere 'round here and chow down?

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Sob… sob…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh? Whazza matter, kid? Whatcha cryin' for?

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: I was on an adventure, and I forgot the way back home. We've only just moved into the neighborhood…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Sheesh, pull yourself together, will ya? All that cryin's just gonna make ya feel worse.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Bet you're hungry, aren't ya? Yeah, guess it's hard to stay positive on an empty stomach.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You're in luck! We just so happen to have some tasty dango right here. Go ahead and dig in.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well? Feel better now that your stomach's full?

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Yes. Thank you, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Looks like ya stopped cryin'. That's a good start! Next up, we gotta getcha home. Do ya know your address?

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It's written on this note.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Sounds like you've got smart parents! Now all that's left is for the great Inari to zip ya there!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. I'm just gonna run this kid back to his folks. Sit tight for a few minutes, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, Inari One hoists the little boy onto her back and dashes off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She shared her dango and also took the boy home, but here I am having done diddly-squat.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Okey doke, I'm back! Got him home, safe and sound!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whazzat? What're ya worryin' 'bout me for?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Seein' that kid's smile was enough to satisfy my appetite!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: …Ah, I guess the smile wasn't enough after all.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wha?! This dango's from that store! Don't tell me ya went back and bought me some?!
choice_data_list: Well, I couldn't just stand around doing nothing.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But, wasn't the store a good trek away? Ya make it sound like it was an easy trip, but…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heh, I see… you're tryna play it down. Pretty classy move, I'd say!
choice_data_list: I learned it from you, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Knock it off! That's embarrassin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But ya know what? It really feels like we've become fantastic partners.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heh heh. Geez! When did ya become so dependable?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One gives me a series of playful slaps on the back.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah. I promised to treat ya to somethin' tasty. Ya almost made me forget!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that kid's big smile and your classy move, this dango's gonna taste amazin'!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I end up making a surprisingly classy memory eating dango together with Inari One.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh-ho, look at you, all fired up! I'm a bit concerned, though…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One suddenly starts poking my thigh!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heh, is it just me, or are these legs feelin' a bit wobbly from all that runnin'?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heh heh. Well, anyway. Ya seem a bit tired, so let's take a breather and get somethin' sweet to nibble on!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: We've both earned it, I'd say!
